info.title: Armada shared control API
info.description: Generated integration REST contracts. Includes SDK operations, launch discovery (launch/options, golden/list) and shared-tool routes. sandbox/launch accepts golden, Docker and explicit pinned Modal template launches. Administrative and provider-specific extensions are outside this description. Files use sandbox/exec while compute runs; declared output snapshots are listed and downloaded with GET sandboxes/{id}/outputs, also after stop. This description does not assert provider availability.

post.description: Gives the agent its next instruction as a new turn. The first send of an idle sandbox opens its conversation and later sends continue it. Launch another sandbox for a separate conversation. To redirect a turn that is still running, use steer. The turn runs with the model and effort chosen at launch; model and reasoning_effort override them for this turn only. Experimental runtime follow-up requires request_id, an empty ready sandbox, existing conversation, or verified empty checkpoint; retained idle pauses wake automatically before expiry. Preserved stopped Boat/Modal sandboxes resume on send; terminal sandboxes refuse controls with recovery guidance. Model/effort remain pinned to launch. A Docker sandbox admits only the Docker sandbox send variant: model and reasoning_effort are refused because they remain pinned to launch. Supply request_id (a lowercase UUID) to replay uncertain delivery; when it is omitted the server generates one.

prompt.description: The instruction: not blank. Over REST the whole serialized JSON request body is limited to 131072 bytes, below Docker's own 256 KiB prompt admission limit, so maxLength is only an upper bound: the other fields, JSON escaping and multibyte UTF-8 count against the same limit.

post.description: Forks a golden into a new sandbox, pulls its repos, runs its init commands, and starts the agent. With `prompt` the agent starts working at once (status running). Without it the sandbox is left ready and the conversation starts at the first `send`. The sandbox gets only your (or your org's) Armada credentials for this agent, never the boat.dev account's. When the caller connected GitHub, git and gh in the sandbox act as that person (8 hour token): see `github` in the answer. Setup can take a few minutes. Docker uses the other request variants: provider "docker" with no golden, either on a hostId (optionally with repos) or from a snapshotId (no repos). launch/options reports each provider's launch sources. For Docker, personal sessions accept an org slug or UUID. Scoped tokens use their org UUID or omit org. Explicit pinned Modal template requests return a durable template launch receipt.

get.description: The files of the sandbox's last output snapshot, from its declared outputs directory (/home/user/outputs on every provider), in name order. Only the sandbox owner or an org admin can read it, the sandbox must not be deleted or application-secret tainted, and stopped compute is never read: the last snapshot taken while compute was live is served. See docs/sandbox-outputs.md. A sandbox.output.available webhook names a new or changed file.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The sandbox id, a lowercase UUID.

directory.description: The declared outputs directory in the sandbox.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 digest of the file bytes. Null for skipped files.

404.description: No such sandbox or file, or the caller is neither its owner nor an org admin, or the sandbox is deleted or application-secret tainted.

get.description: Download one file of the sandbox's last output snapshot as an attachment. Only the sandbox owner or an org admin can read it, the sandbox must not be deleted or application-secret tainted, and stopped compute is never read: the last snapshot taken while compute was live is served. See docs/sandbox-outputs.md.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The sandbox id, a lowercase UUID.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: One byte range, for example bytes=0-1023.

parameters.name: If-Range
parameters.description: Apply the Range only when the file's ETag matches.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The file name from the outputs list, percent-encoded as one path segment.

200.description: The file bytes. Content-Type is inferred from the file name, else application/octet-stream.

Content-Disposition.description: attachment, with the UTF-8 file name (filename*).

404.description: No such sandbox or file, or the caller is neither its owner nor an org admin, or the sandbox is deleted or application-secret tainted.

416.description: The byte range is invalid or unsatisfiable.

503.description: Stored outputs cannot be decrypted on this server, or the API is temporarily unavailable.

error.description: Bare failure code answered by the outputs routes, for example not_found or invalid_name.

code.description: Public failure code; clients must tolerate future codes.
